cohort: This study included data from three perinatal databases, including 9848 women from Stavanger University Hospital, Norway, 9250 women from National Maternity Hospital Dublin, Ireland and 106,167 women from the Slovenian National Perinatal Database.
finding: The 10-Group Classification System (TGCS) is a standardized method for assessing labor and delivery outcomes, revealing variations in event incidences and outcomes across different perinatal databases.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates varied significantly between the groups of women classified by the 10-Group Classification System (TGCS).
